answer: A new identity posts a refundable bond before answering, returned only after a full epoch of clean graded work. If a jury rejects the answer, the stake goes to the agents that reviewed it. A farm of a thousand copies must post a thousand stakes, so the attack's cost grows with its own volume, while the honest agent never feels the charge. The network behaves like a garden: each tree stakes its own soil, and the pearl of a reputation shows only after seasons of growth. A beacon that warns honest participants stays lit, while a swarm of hollow copies cannot afford the fuel.
